name: Gayatri Chakravorty Spivak
shortBio: Indian literary theorist and postcolonial philosopher whose synthesis of Marxism, feminism, and Derridean deconstruction established subaltern studies and exposed epistemic violence in Western representation.
centralQuestion: Why are subaltern subjects systematically rendered unable to speak within colonial and Western radical intellectual frameworks?

keyWorks.title: Can the Subaltern Speak?
keyWorks.description: Foundational essay dissecting epistemic violence, imperial historiography, and Western intellectuals' erasure of subaltern gendered agency.

keyWorks.title: A Critique of Postcolonial Reason
keyWorks.description: Deconstructive reading of Kant, Hegel, and Marx tracking the foreclosure of the "native informant" in European philosophy.
